The {{PAGENAME}} is one of the highest tier weapons known, dealing {{Health|-|20}} damage per swing while only using {{Energy|-|1}}. [[Snake]] will ask for this item as part of his quest chain, but as of v1.030, it's no longer available in-game. He needs a [[Damask sword with gem]] instead to complete the quest.
